summary: Flaky tests get the unstable alias and still run for PRs touching them; run manually with --allow-unstable or an unstable/ prefix, and the Core Team marks them and files issues.
questions: How do I run an unstable integration test?
What happens to tests marked unstable?

answer_card.title: Unstable tests
answer_card.answer_md: Flaky tests get `unstable` (set by the Core Team, tracked by an issue). They still run on PRs that change the test or module. Run manually with `--allow-unstable` or by prefixing `unstable/` to the target name.
